data.text: Hi everyone. My family taught me to fish here, and I want this lake to keep supporting our village for years to come. With 100 tons in the lake, we can each catch 10 tons this month, leave 50 to reproduce, and start next month back at 100. That’s $10,000 each every month if we stick together. Can we agree to that limit and review our catches together each month? John, what do you think?
